I called microtubule stabilizers on the strength of very large tubulin signals at 1.5-15 uM (tub_glcm_contrast z +23.9 to +42.1, tub_mean z +11.9 to +35.6) and microscopist reports of bundles, supported by dose trends for tub_mean and multinucleation. The unblinded compound was cycloheximide, an 80S ribosome inhibitor, so the tubulin brightening was non-specific.

What misled me was treating intensity and texture as mechanism-specific while discounting the atlas, which gave Epithelial 3/4 with zero votes for stabilizers, and the replicate discordance at 1.5 uM (rep1 tub_mean +11.9 versus rep2 +1.6). Actin texture was also very high and cell count fell with dose with lower density, more consistent with translation arrest and compaction/rounding than with stabilized microtubules, but I had no protein-synthesis hypothesis to test.

The error was confirmation bias on 4 wells over 3 doses: I used weak p~0.051 Spearman trends to confirm stabilization and omitted the discordant well from the first conclusion, then used describe_phenotype to re-confirm bundles rather than to falsify rounding artifacts.

Never included Protein synthesis in hypothesis set, so no acquisition was designed to test translation inhibition

citations.claim: Cycloheximide unblinded here acts as an 80S ribosome inhibitor blocking translation, consistent with targeting the human 80S ribosome (PMID 32151059).
Protein synthesis inhibitors acting on 80S ribosomes define the true protein-synthesis class missed in the hypothesis set (PMID 7201003).

reflection.next_experiment: Direct protein-synthesis test: puromycin-incorporation or 35S-methionine labeling dose-response with cycloheximide reference versus a microtubule-stabilizer reference, paired with high-resolution tubulin plus DNA imaging and washout to determine if tubulin brightening/bundling is secondary to rounding/compaction and reversible when translation resumes.

- Over-weighted tub_mean and tub_glcm_contrast magnitude as specific for stabilization, ignoring brightness from rounding/compaction and concurrent act_glcm_contrast z +24.4

- Relied on 4-well dose_response trends with p~0.26-0.051 as confirmatory and omitted discordant rep2 well from early hypothesis weighting
- Never included Protein synthesis in hypothesis set, so no acquisition was designed to test translation inhibition
